name: concat_and_cast_mha_k
description: MLA KV concatenation/cast with signature concat_and_cast_mha_k(k, k_nope, k_rope). k is [t,h,nope_dim+rope_dim] and supplies the output shape, device and dtype; k_nope is [t,h,nope_dim]; k_rope is [t,1,rope_dim]. Return a newly allocated tensor of k.dtype and shape [t,h,nope_dim+rope_dim] whose first nope_dim columns are k_nope and whose remaining rope_dim columns are k_rope broadcast over all h heads. The values of k are not copied; it is used only as output metadata. No input is modified. The suite exercises bfloat16 with h 16/32/128 and rope_dim 64.
